name: Ocean drum & distant gongs
desc: A wide ambient wash: the vcsl ocean drum rolls its beads with a slow tidal filter breath and a broad opposite-phase pan sweep, while distant gongs and gong2 strike on the downbeat and alternate at phrase ends, drenched in reverb. A high sped-up wash layer shimmers on top. Peak swells into an ocean storm with a gong gamelan and lastOf fills. Unpitched atmosphere.

code.peak: stack(s("oceandrum*4").gain(${gain}*.95).lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.6, ${cut}*1.5).slow(16)).hpf(160).pan(sine.range(.22,.78).slow(20)).room(${room}), s("[oceandrum ~]*4").gain(${gain}*.55).speed(1.6).hpf(1800).pan(cosine.range(.75,.25).slow(16)), s("gong ~ gong2 ~ <gong ~> ~ gong2 ~").gain(${gain}*.85).room(.65).lpf(sine.range(1800,4500).slow(16)).pan(cosine.range(.65,.35).slow(16)).every(4, x=>x.ply(2)), s("[~ gong2]*2").gain(${gain}*.45).speed(1.5).room(.7).hpf(1200).lpf(sine.range(2500,5000).slow(24))).lastOf(4, x=>x.fast(2)).fast(${rate}).orbit(7).play()
